task.title: Customize AI Support for Commit Messages and Commit Explanations
task.shortdesc: Configure the Git Client AI settings so commit messages and commit explanations follow your project's conventions.

context.p: The Git Client provides an AI preferences page where you can control how AI-generated commit messages and commit explanations are produced. Use these settings to add project-specific instructions, control how much context is sent to AI, and align the generated output with your team's conventions.

step.cmd: To open the Preferences menu, from the main menu bar, go to Options > Preferences .
To open the Git Client AI preferences page, on Preferences, go to the left sidebar and select Plugins > Git Client > AI.

fig.title: Navigating to the AI preferences page

step.cmd: On Commit Message Generation, enter specific instructions for AI-generated commit messages.
On Explain Commits, enter specific instructions for AI-generated commit explanations.
On Context, adjust the maximum amount of characters sent to AI models and the number of recent commit messages included as writing style context.
Select OK or Apply to save your settings.

result.p: AI-generated commit messages and commit explanations use your custom instructions and context settings.

postreq.p: You can save these settings in an project file so the same AI guidance is shared across a team. When generating a commit message, the AI can also take into account the current branch name, recent commit messages, and any draft text already entered in the Commit message field.
